@edenhaus @joostlek just to make sure everyone is on the same page: Blink changed their API to report something different for their wifi measurement than they used to. So the current implementation in home-assistant is broken due to this change (ie. The sensor is incorrect in home assistant). This change fixes home assistant to match what is reported by Blink.
